# Preprocessing

```{r}
# Normalize long s
texts_adj_s <- str_replace_all(texts, "ſ", "s")
names(texts_adj_s) <- names(texts)

# Remove uncommon symbols
texts_adj_s <- str_replace_all(texts_adj_s, "[●▪◊]", "")
names(texts_adj_s) <- names(texts)

# Build corpus
corp <- corpus(texts_adj_s)

# Create a vector of custom stopwords for removal
custom_stop <- c(
  "vnto","haue","doo","hath","bee","ye","thee","hee","shall","hast","doe",
  "beene","thereof","thus" 
)


# Create a vector single letters for removal
single_letters <- c(letters)

# Tokenize + Clean
toks <- tokens(
  corp,
  remove_punct   = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE,
  remove_symbols = TRUE
) |>
  tokens_tolower() |>
  tokens_remove(c(stopwords("en"), custom_stop, single_letters)) |>
  tokens_remove(pattern = "^[0-9]", valuetype = "regex")
```


# TF-IDF

```{r}
dfm_mat <- dfm(toks)
dfm_mat
```

```{r}
dfm_tfidf <- dfm_tfidf(dfm_mat)
dfm_tfidf
```

```{r}
tfidf_mat <- as.matrix(dfm_tfidf)
```

```{r}
top_terms_table <- dfm_tfidf |>
  convert(to = "data.frame") |>
  rename(document = doc_id) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "tfidf"
  ) |>
  group_by(document) |>
  slice_max(tfidf, n = 15) |>
  arrange(document, desc(tfidf)) |>
  ungroup()

top_terms_table

write.csv(top_terms_table, "../results/Tables/top_terms_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```



```{r}
shared_terms_with_texts <- top_terms_table |>
  group_by(term) |>
  filter(n_distinct(document) > 1) |>
  summarise(
    n_documents = n_distinct(document),
    texts = paste(unique(document), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_documents))

shared_terms_with_texts[1:5,]
paste(
  "Number of terms with a top 15 TF-IDF score in at least 2 documents: ",
  nrow(shared_terms_with_texts)
)

write.csv(shared_terms_with_texts, "../results/Tables/shared_terms_with_texts.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

# Pearson Correlation
```{r}
dfm_mat_trimmed <- dfm_trim(dfm_mat, min_termfreq = 5)

# correlation similarity
sim_cor <- textstat_simil(
  dfm_mat_trimmed,
  method = "correlation",
  margin = "documents"
)
```

```{r}
# Convert similarity object to a matrix 
r_mat <- as.matrix(sim_cor) 
# Take a quick look 
dim(r_mat) 
r_mat[1:5, 1:5] 
# rounding correlation for readability (see explanation below)
r_mat <- round(r_mat, 3) 
# Long format for ggplot  
heat_df <- as.data.frame(r_mat) %>%  
rownames_to_column("doc_i") %>% # First document in pair  
pivot_longer(-doc_i, names_to = "doc_j", values_to = "r") # Second document + correlation  
# create the heatmap  
heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = doc_j, y = doc_i, fill = r)) +  
geom_tile(color = "grey80") + # Create colored tiles
geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 1.5) +
coord_fixed() + # Keep tiles square  
scale_fill_gradient2(  
                       low = "blue",   
                        mid = "white",  
                         high = "red",  
                         midpoint = 0  # Center color scale at 0  
) +  
labs( title = "Pearson Correlation Between Documents",  
x = NULL,  
y = NULL,  
fill = "Correlation" 
) + theme_minimal() +  
theme(  
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  
panel.grid = element_blank() 
)

ggsave("../results/Figures/heatmap.png", plot = heatmap_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Remove self-correlations (diagonal)
heat_df_unique <- heat_df %>%
  filter(doc_i != doc_j) %>%  # remove diagonal
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(doc_i, doc_j)), collapse = "_")) %>%  # make unique pairs
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-pair)  # drop the helper column

# Top 2 correlations
top_5 <- heat_df_unique %>%
  arrange(desc(r)) %>%
  slice(1:5)

# Bottom 2 correlations
bottom_5 <- heat_df_unique %>%
  arrange(r) %>%
  slice(1:5)

top_5
bottom_5

write.csv(top_5, "../results/Tables/top_5.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bottom_5, "../results/Tables/bottom_5.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Syntactic Complexity Profile
```{r}
texts_df <- tibble(
  document = names(texts_adj_s),
  text = as.character(texts_adj_s)
) %>%
  filter(document %in% c("Text U", "Text V"))
```

```{r}
#Load an English UD (= Univesal Dependencies) model ONCE

model_info <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english-ewt")
ud_model <- udpipe_load_model(model_info$file_model)
```

```{r}
anno_df <- texts_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Parse each text with the UD parser; set doc_id to our document name
    anno = map2(text, document, ~ udpipe_annotate(ud_model, x = .x, doc_id = .y) %>%
      as.data.frame())
  ) %>%
  # Keep only parsed annotations, then unnest into rows
  select(anno) %>%
  unnest(anno) %>%
  # Use the UD doc_id as our document label (and drop any duplicates cleanly)
  rename(document = doc_id) %>%
  # Select columns for syntactic analysis
  select(
    document,
    paragraph_id,
    sentence_id,
    token_id,
    token,
    lemma,
    upos,          # part of speech
    feats,         # grammatical features (e.g., verb form)
    head_token_id, # head of dependency relation
    dep_rel        # dependency relation type
  )

anno_df %>% glimpse()
```


```{r}
syntax_df <- anno_df %>%
mutate(
is_word = upos != "PUNCT", #<--is it a word (and not punctuation?)


# Is this an independent clause? finite verbs are proxy for independent clauses
is_clause = (upos %in% c("VERB", "AUX")) &
            str_detect(coalesce(feats, ""), "VerbForm=Fin"),

# Dependent clause? 
is_dep_clause = dep_rel %in% c(
  "advcl", #adverbial clause 
  "ccomp", # clausal complement
  "xcomp", #open clausal complement
  "acl", #adnomial clause
  "acl:relcl" #relative clause
),

# Is this coordination? That is, does it use "and" "or" etc.?
is_coord = dep_rel %in% c("conj", "cc"),

# Nominal complexity: these relations make noun phrases more complex
is_complex_nominal = dep_rel %in% c(
  "amod", # adjective modifier ("big cup")
  "nmod", #nominal modifier ("cup of tea")
  "compound", # compound ("lemon tea")
  "appos" #apposition ("tea, my favorite!")
)

)
```


```{r}
sentence_df <- syntax_df %>%
  filter(is_word) %>%           #count words (not punctuation)
  group_by(document, sentence_id) %>%   #group by document and sentence
  summarise(
    words          = n(),   #number of words per sentence
    clauses        = sum(is_clause), # number of clauses per sentence
    dep_clauses    = sum(is_dep_clause), #number of dependent clauses per sentence
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sentence_df
```


```{r}
mls_df <- sentence_df %>%
group_by(document) %>%
summarise(
MLS = mean(words), # Average words per sentence
.groups = "drop"
)

# Let's take a look
mls_df 
```

```{r}
#Calculate clauses per sentence
clausal_density_df <- sentence_df %>%
group_by(document) %>%
summarise(
sentences = n(),
clauses   = sum(clauses),
C_per_S   = clauses / sentences,
.groups = "drop"
)

# Let's check and how do they compare?
clausal_density_df
```

```{r}
subordination_df <- sentence_df %>%
group_by(document) %>%
summarise(
clauses = sum(clauses),
dep_clauses = sum(dep_clauses),
sentences = n(),
DC_per_C = dep_clauses / pmax(clauses, 1), #avoid division by 0 (shouldn't happen, but if no clauses were detected in the sentence, we still want it to run)
DC_per_S = dep_clauses / sentences,
.groups = "drop"
)

subordination_df
```

```{r}
coordination_df <- syntax_df %>%
group_by(document) %>%
summarise(
coord_relations = sum(is_coord),
clauses         = sum(is_clause),
sentences       = n_distinct(sentence_id),
Coord_per_C     = coord_relations / pmax(clauses, 1),
Coord_per_S     = coord_relations / sentences,
.groups = "drop"
)

coordination_df
```

```{r}
nominal_df <- syntax_df %>%
group_by(document) %>%
summarise(
complex_nominals = sum(is_complex_nominal),
clauses          = sum(is_clause),
sentences        = n_distinct(sentence_id),
CN_per_C         = complex_nominals / pmax(clauses, 1),
CN_per_S         = complex_nominals / sentences,
.groups = "drop"
)

nominal_df
```

```{r}
# Combine all measures
all_measures <- mls_df %>%  # ← Added mls_df %>%
  left_join(clausal_density_df %>% select(document, C_per_S), by = "document") %>%
  left_join(subordination_df %>% select(document, DC_per_C, DC_per_S), by = "document") %>%
  left_join(coordination_df %>% select(document, Coord_per_C, Coord_per_S), by = "document") %>%
  left_join(nominal_df %>% select(document, CN_per_C, CN_per_S), by = "document")
all_measures

write.csv(all_measures, "../results/Tables/all_measures.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Reshape for plotting
syntax_long <- all_measures %>%  # ← Added %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -document,
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Measure == "MLS" ~ "Sentence Length",
      Measure == "C_per_S" ~ "Clausal Density",
      Measure %in% c("DC_per_C", "DC_per_S") ~ "Subordination",
      Measure %in% c("Coord_per_C", "Coord_per_S") ~ "Coordination",
      Measure %in% c("CN_per_C", "CN_per_S") ~ "Phrasal Complexity"
    )
  )

# Plot
syntax_plot <- ggplot(syntax_long, aes(x = Measure, y = Value, fill = document)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Syntactic Complexity: Complete Profile",
    subtitle = "Comparing multiple dimensions of syntactic complexity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Document"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
ggsave("../results/Figures/syntactic_complexity_profile.png", plot = syntax_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
# --- Extract complete sentences near MLS targets for Text U (~43 words) and Text V (~23 words) ---

# 1. Reconstruct full sentences from UD tokens
sentences_full <- anno_df %>%
  group_by(document, sentence_id) %>%
  summarise(sentence_text = paste(token, collapse = " "),
            .groups = "drop")

# 2. Attach sentence text to sentence-level metrics
sentence_df2 <- sentence_df %>%
  left_join(sentences_full, by = c("document", "sentence_id"))

# 3. Target MLS values
target_U <- 43
target_V <- 23

# 4. Keep only complete sentences that end with a period
sentence_df_clean <- sentence_df2 %>%
  filter(str_detect(sentence_text, "\\.$"))

# 5. Select the sentence closest to the target for each text
mls_examples <- sentence_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    target = if_else(document == "Text U", target_U, target_V),
    distance = abs(words - target)
  ) %>%
  group_by(document) %>%
  slice_min(distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(document, words, sentence_text)

mls_examples

```
